# test a example
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(MorphoGAM)
library(tidyverse)
library(tibble)
library(transport)
library(readr)
library(pheatmap)


# ============================================================
# Randomly select one D0 slice and one D9 slice from all_slices
# and combine them into dat for testing
# Keep dat looking like the original file: x, y, Mouse_ID, ...
# ============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(tibble)

set.seed(56)

slice_dir <- Sys.getenv("ALL_SLICES", "all_slices")   # per-section tables from export_colon_sections.py (run from reproducibility/)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. List all CSV slice files
# ------------------------------------------------------------

slice_files <- list.files(
  path = slice_dir,
  pattern = "\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

slice_table <- tibble(
  file = slice_files,
  file_name = basename(slice_files)
) %>%
  mutate(
    Sample_type_from_file = case_when(
      str_detect(file_name, "_D0_") ~ "Healthy",
      str_detect(file_name, "_D9_") ~ "DSS9",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Sample_type_from_file))

slice_table %>%
  count(Sample_type_from_file)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Randomly choose one D0 and one D9 slice
# ------------------------------------------------------------

chosen_D0 <- slice_table %>%
  filter(Sample_type_from_file == "Healthy") %>%
  slice_sample(n = 1)

chosen_D9 <- slice_table %>%
  filter(Sample_type_from_file == "DSS9") %>%
  slice_sample(n = 1)

chosen_slices <- bind_rows(chosen_D0, chosen_D9)

chosen_slices

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Read one slice cleanly
# ------------------------------------------------------------

read_one_slice_clean <- function(file, sample_type_from_file) {
  
  df <- read_csv(file, show_col_types = FALSE)
  
  # Remove unnamed index column if present
  if ("...1" %in% colnames(df)) {
    df <- df %>%
      select(-`...1`)
  }
  
  # Ensure sample type and slice ID are correct
  df %>%
    mutate(
      Sample_type = sample_type_from_file,
      Slice_ID = str_remove(basename(file), "\\.csv$"),
      source_file = basename(file)
    )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Combine selected D0 and D9 slices
# ------------------------------------------------------------

dat <- bind_rows(
  read_one_slice_clean(chosen_D0$file, chosen_D0$Sample_type_from_file),
  read_one_slice_clean(chosen_D9$file, chosen_D9$Sample_type_from_file)
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Make sure dat has default row numbers, not custom row names
# ------------------------------------------------------------

dat <- dat %>%
  as.data.frame()

rownames(dat) <- NULL

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Quick checks
# ------------------------------------------------------------

dat %>%
  count(Sample_type, Slice_ID)

dat %>%
  count(Sample_type)

dat %>%
  count(
    Sample_type,
    layer = case_when(
      grepl("^MU", Leiden_neigh) ~ "MU",
      grepl("^SM", Leiden_neigh) ~ "SM",
      grepl("^ME", Leiden_neigh) ~ "ME",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  )

dat %>%
  count(Sample_type, Tier1, Tier2) %>%
  arrange(Sample_type, Tier1, desc(n))
```

## apply morphogam
```{r}
library(MorphoGAM)

run_curve_layers <- function(dat_use, layers_use, output_name = NULL,
                             prefix = "Healthy_2", knn = NULL, manual = FALSE,
                             r_flip = FALSE) {
  
  if (is.null(output_name)) {
    output_name <- paste(layers_use, collapse = "_")
  }
  
  message("Running layers: ", paste(layers_use, collapse = " + "))
  
  dat_sub <- dat_use %>%
    filter(layer %in% layers_use) %>%
    filter(is.finite(x), is.finite(y))
  
  xy <- as.matrix(dat_sub[, c("x", "y")])
  
  if (manual) {
    fit <- CurveFinderInteractive(xy)
  } else {
    if (is.null(knn)) {
      fit <- CurveFinder(xy)
    } else {
      fit <- CurveFinder(xy, knn = knn)
    }
  }
  
  print(fit$curve.plot)
  print(fit$coordinate.plot)
  print(fit$residuals.plot)
  
  xyt_mapped <- as.data.frame(fit$xyt) %>%
    bind_cols(
      dat_sub %>%
        select(
          layer,
          Tier1,
          Tier2,
          Tier3,
          Leiden_neigh,
          Sample_type,
          Slice_ID,
          Cell_ID
        )
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      r_original = as.numeric(r),
      r_for_jsd = if (isTRUE(r_flip)) {
        1 - r_original
      } else {
        r_original
      }
    )
  
  write_csv(
    xyt_mapped,
    file.path(outdir, paste0(prefix, "_xyt_mapped_", output_name, ".csv"))
  )
  
  return(list(
    fit = fit,
    xyt_mapped = xyt_mapped
  ))
}

curve_MU <- run_curve_layers(
  dat_layer_gt30,
  layers_use = "MU",
  output_name = "MU",
  prefix = "Healthy",
  manual = FALSE,
  r_flip = FALSE
)

curve_SM <- run_curve_layers(
  dat_layer_gt30,
  layers_use = "SM",
  output_name = "SM",
  prefix = "Healthy",
  manual = TRUE,
  r_flip = FALSE
)

curve_ME <- run_curve_layers(
  dat_layer_gt30,
  layers_use = "ME",
  output_name = "ME",
  prefix = "Healthy",
  manual = TRUE,
  r_flip = FALSE
)
```

# Spatial similarity
## Step 1. Compute layer-specific spatial similarity
```{r}
# ============================================================
# Helper functions for KDE-based Jensen-Shannon distance
# ============================================================

clean_xyt <- function(df, coord = "r_for_jsd") {
  
  df %>%
    transmute(
      Tier2 = as.character(Tier2),
      value = as.numeric(.data[[coord]])
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(Tier2),
      is.finite(value),
      value >= 0,
      value <= 1
    )
}

js_dist_kde <- function(x, y, n = 512, bw) {
  
  x <- x[is.finite(x) & x >= 0 & x <= 1]
  y <- y[is.finite(y) & y >= 0 & y <= 1]
  
  if (length(x) < 2 || length(y) < 2) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  
  denx <- density(x, from = 0, to = 1, n = n, bw = bw)
  deny <- density(y, from = 0, to = 1, n = n, bw = bw)
  
  dx <- denx$x[2] - denx$x[1]
  
  px <- denx$y * dx
  py <- deny$y * dx
  
  px <- px / sum(px)
  py <- py / sum(py)
  
  m <- 0.5 * (px + py)
  
  eps <- 1e-12
  
  kl <- function(a, b) {
    sum(a * log((a + eps) / (b + eps)))
  }
  
  js <- 0.5 * kl(px, m) + 0.5 * kl(py, m)
  
  sqrt(js)
}
# ============================================================
# Step 1. Compute layer-specific spatial similarity
# ============================================================
# Rationale:
# MU, SM, and ME are fitted separately in MorphoGAM, so their
# residual coordinates r_MU, r_SM, and r_ME should not be pooled.
#
# Therefore, spatial similarity is computed only within matched
# anatomical layers:
#   Healthy MU vs DSS9 MU
#   Healthy SM vs DSS9 SM
#   Healthy ME vs DSS9 ME
#
# For each layer, KDE-based Jensen-Shannon divergence is computed
# on the MorphoGAM coordinate r_for_jsd, and then converted to
# a similarity score:
#   S_l,ij = exp(-D_l,ij / sigma_l)
# ============================================================

compute_same_layer_jsd <- function(layer_name, coord = "r_for_jsd",
                                   plot_heatmap = TRUE) {
  
  message("Computing Healthy ", layer_name, " vs DSS9 ", layer_name,
          " using ", coord)
  
  healthy_file <- file.path(outdir, paste0("Healthy_xyt_mapped_", layer_name, ".csv"))
  dss9_file    <- file.path(outdir, paste0("DSS9_xyt_mapped_", layer_name, ".csv"))
  
  d0 <- read_csv(healthy_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    clean_xyt(coord = coord)
  
  d9 <- read_csv(dss9_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    clean_xyt(coord = coord)
  
  rows <- sort(unique(d0$Tier2))
  cols <- sort(unique(d9$Tier2))
  
  r0_list <- split(d0$value, d0$Tier2)
  r9_list <- split(d9$value, d9$Tier2)
  
  bw_global <- bw.nrd0(c(d0$value, d9$value))
  
  if (!is.finite(bw_global) || bw_global <= 0) {
    bw_global <- 0.05
  }
  
  D <- matrix(
    NA_real_,
    nrow = length(rows),
    ncol = length(cols),
    dimnames = list(rows, cols)
  )
  
  for (i in seq_along(rows)) {
    for (j in seq_along(cols)) {
      D[i, j] <- js_dist_kde(
        r0_list[[rows[i]]],
        r9_list[[cols[j]]],
        bw = bw_global
      )
    }
  }
  
  sigma <- as.numeric(quantile(D, 0.5, na.rm = TRUE))
  
  if (!is.finite(sigma) || sigma <= 0) {
    sigma <- mean(D[is.finite(D)], na.rm = TRUE)
  }
  
  if (!is.finite(sigma) || sigma <= 0) {
    sigma <- 1
  }
  
  S <- exp(-D / sigma)
  
  write_csv(
    as.data.frame(D) %>%
      rownames_to_column("Healthy_Tier2"),
    file.path(outdir, paste0("Healthy_vs_DSS9_", layer_name, "_", coord, "_JSD_distance.csv"))
  )
  
  write_csv(
    as.data.frame(S) %>%
      rownames_to_column("Healthy_Tier2"),
    file.path(outdir, paste0("Healthy_vs_DSS9_", layer_name, "_", coord, "_JSD_similarity.csv"))
  )
  
  finite_vals <- S[is.finite(S)]
  
  if (plot_heatmap && length(unique(round(finite_vals, 8))) > 1) {
    pheatmap(
      S,
      cluster_rows = FALSE,
      cluster_cols = FALSE,
      main = paste0("Healthy vs DSS9 ", layer_name, " spatial similarity using ", coord),
      fontsize_row = 7,
      fontsize_col = 7
    )
  } else {
    message("Skipping heatmap for ", layer_name,
            ": similarity matrix has too few unique finite values.")
  }
  
  return(list(
    D = D,
    S = S,
    bw_global = bw_global,
    sigma = sigma,
    coord = coord,
    layer = layer_name
  ))
}

jsd_MU <- compute_same_layer_jsd("MU", coord = "r_for_jsd")
jsd_SM <- compute_same_layer_jsd("SM", coord = "r_for_jsd")
jsd_ME <- compute_same_layer_jsd("ME", coord = "r_for_jsd")
```

## Step 2. Cell-count-weighted summary of valid within-layer similarities

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Step 2. Cell-count-weighted summary of valid layer-specific similarities
# ============================================================
# Rationale:
# The layer-specific similarities S_l,ij are valid because each was
# computed within a matched layer-specific coordinate system.
#
# Here, we summarize those layer-specific similarities using
# cell-count weights:
#
#   w_l,ij = sqrt(n^Healthy_l,i * n^DSS9_l,j)
#
#   S_summary_ij =
#       sum_l w_l,ij * S_l,ij / sum_l w_l,ij
#
# Important interpretation:
# This is a weighted summary of valid within-layer similarities.
# It is NOT a formal spatial distance on one pooled coordinate space.
# ============================================================

jsd_list <- list(
  MU = jsd_MU,
  SM = jsd_SM,
  ME = jsd_ME
)

layers <- c("MU", "SM", "ME")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Counts used for weighting Step 2
# These are from the MorphoGAM xyt files, i.e. the same filtered
# cells used to compute layer-specific spatial similarity.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

get_xyt_counts <- function(layer_name, prefix) {
  
  read_csv(
    file.path(outdir, paste0(prefix, "_xyt_mapped_", layer_name, ".csv")),
    show_col_types = FALSE
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      Tier2 = as.character(Tier2),
      layer = as.character(layer)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Tier2), layer == layer_name) %>%
    count(Tier2, name = "n") %>%
    mutate(layer = layer_name)
}

healthy_xyt_counts_all <- bind_rows(
  get_xyt_counts("MU", "Healthy"),
  get_xyt_counts("SM", "Healthy"),
  get_xyt_counts("ME", "Healthy")
)

dss9_xyt_counts_all <- bind_rows(
  get_xyt_counts("MU", "DSS9"),
  get_xyt_counts("SM", "DSS9"),
  get_xyt_counts("ME", "DSS9")
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Initialize matrices
# ------------------------------------------------------------

all_rows <- sort(unique(unlist(lapply(jsd_list, function(x) rownames(x$S)))))
all_cols <- sort(unique(unlist(lapply(jsd_list, function(x) colnames(x$S)))))

S_num_count <- matrix(
  0,
  nrow = length(all_rows),
  ncol = length(all_cols),
  dimnames = list(all_rows, all_cols)
)

S_den_count <- matrix(
  0,
  nrow = length(all_rows),
  ncol = length(all_cols),
  dimnames = list(all_rows, all_cols)
)

layer_coverage_count <- matrix(
  0,
  nrow = length(all_rows),
  ncol = length(all_cols),
  dimnames = list(all_rows, all_cols)
)

cell_weight_sum <- matrix(
  0,
  nrow = length(all_rows),
  ncol = length(all_cols),
  dimnames = list(all_rows, all_cols)
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Weighted summary across MU / SM / ME
# ------------------------------------------------------------

for (ly in layers) {
  
  S_layer <- jsd_list[[ly]]$S
  
  n0_layer <- healthy_xyt_counts_all %>%
    filter(layer == ly)
  
  n9_layer <- dss9_xyt_counts_all %>%
    filter(layer == ly)
  
  for (i in rownames(S_layer)) {
    for (j in colnames(S_layer)) {
      
      sij <- S_layer[i, j]
      if (!is.finite(sij)) next
      
      n_i <- n0_layer %>%
        filter(Tier2 == i) %>%
        pull(n)
      
      n_j <- n9_layer %>%
        filter(Tier2 == j) %>%
        pull(n)
      
      if (length(n_i) == 0 || length(n_j) == 0) next
      
      w <- sqrt(n_i * n_j)
      if (!is.finite(w) || w <= 0) next
      
      S_num_count[i, j] <- S_num_count[i, j] + w * sij
      S_den_count[i, j] <- S_den_count[i, j] + w
      layer_coverage_count[i, j] <- layer_coverage_count[i, j] + 1
      cell_weight_sum[i, j] <- cell_weight_sum[i, j] + w
    }
  }
}

S_summary_count <- S_num_count / S_den_count
S_summary_count[S_den_count == 0] <- NA
```

## Step 3. Anatomical mixture correction using unfiltered layer proportions

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Step 3. Correct for anatomical mixture compatibility
# using filtered MorphoGAM-retained cells
# ============================================================
# Rationale:
# A cell type is not only a distribution along r_l within each
# layer. It is also a mixture over anatomical layers:
#
#   P_i(l, r_l) = p_i,l * P_i,l(r_l)
#
# Here, p_i,l is computed from the same filtered xyt_mapped files
# used in Step 1 and Step 2. These xyt_mapped files should already
# reflect the >30 cells per Tier2-per-layer filtering.
#
# Therefore, Step 3 uses the same analysis universe as the spatial
# similarity calculation.
#
# Layer-distribution overlap:
#
#   O_ij = sum_l sqrt(p^Healthy_l,i * p^DSS9_l,j)
#
# Optional sharpening:
#
#   O^gamma_ij = O_ij^gamma
#
# where:
#   gamma = 1   means no sharpening
#   gamma > 1   penalizes partial layer-distribution mismatch more strongly
#
# Final composite score:
#
#   S_final_ij = S_summary_ij * O^gamma_ij
#
# This is a mixture-aware composite similarity index, not a pure
# pooled-space JSD distance.
# ============================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Choose sharpening strength
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# gamma = 1: no sharpening, original Bhattacharyya overlap
# gamma = 1.5: mild sharpening
# gamma = 2: moderate sharpening
# gamma = 3: strong sharpening

gamma <- 1

layers <- c("MU", "SM", "ME")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Read filtered Healthy and DSS9 xyt_mapped files
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# These files are expected to come from:
#   dat_layer_gt30
#   dat_dss9_layer_gt30
#
# Therefore, they already reflect the >30 cells per Tier2-per-layer
# filtering used before MorphoGAM.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

read_filtered_xyt <- function(prefix) {
  
  bind_rows(
    read_csv(
      file.path(outdir, paste0(prefix, "_xyt_mapped_MU.csv")),
      show_col_types = FALSE
    ),
    read_csv(
      file.path(outdir, paste0(prefix, "_xyt_mapped_SM.csv")),
      show_col_types = FALSE
    ),
    read_csv(
      file.path(outdir, paste0(prefix, "_xyt_mapped_ME.csv")),
      show_col_types = FALSE
    )
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      Tier1 = as.character(Tier1),
      Tier2 = as.character(Tier2),
      layer = as.character(layer)
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(Tier2),
      !is.na(layer),
      layer %in% layers
    )
}

healthy_xyt_filtered <- read_filtered_xyt("Healthy")
dss9_xyt_filtered    <- read_filtered_xyt("DSS9")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Optional verification: check minimum cells per retained layer
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# This lets you confirm that the retained layer-cell-type combinations
# are indeed mostly >30 cells.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

healthy_filtered_counts_check <- healthy_xyt_filtered %>%
  count(layer, Tier2, name = "n_cells") %>%
  arrange(layer, n_cells)

dss9_filtered_counts_check <- dss9_xyt_filtered %>%
  count(layer, Tier2, name = "n_cells") %>%
  arrange(layer, n_cells)

healthy_filtered_counts_check %>%
  summarise(
    min_n_cells = min(n_cells),
    n_layer_tier2_combinations = n()
  )

dss9_filtered_counts_check %>%
  summarise(
    min_n_cells = min(n_cells),
    n_layer_tier2_combinations = n()
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Compute filtered layer proportions p_l,i
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# For each Tier2 cell type, proportions are calculated across
# retained MU / SM / ME layers:
#
#   p_l,i = n_l,i / sum_l n_l,i
#
# Because this uses filtered xyt_mapped files, rare layer appearances
# dropped before MorphoGAM are not included.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

get_filtered_layer_props <- function(df) {
  
  df %>%
    count(Tier2, layer, name = "n") %>%
    group_by(Tier2) %>%
    mutate(
      total_n = sum(n),
      p = n / total_n
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(Tier2, layer, n, total_n, p)
}

healthy_layer_props <- get_filtered_layer_props(healthy_xyt_filtered)
dss9_layer_props    <- get_filtered_layer_props(dss9_xyt_filtered)

write_csv(
  healthy_layer_props,
  file.path(outdir, "Healthy_filtered_Tier2_layer_proportions_gt30.csv")
)

write_csv(
  dss9_layer_props,
  file.path(outdir, "DSS9_filtered_Tier2_layer_proportions_gt30.csv")
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Compute layer-distribution overlap O_ij
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# layer_distribution_overlap:
#   original Bhattacharyya overlap, between 0 and 1
#
# layer_distribution_overlap_gamma:
#   sharpened overlap, O_ij^gamma
# ------------------------------------------------------------

layer_distribution_overlap <- matrix(
  NA_real_,
  nrow = nrow(S_summary_count),
  ncol = ncol(S_summary_count),
  dimnames = dimnames(S_summary_count)
)

for (i in rownames(S_summary_count)) {
  for (j in colnames(S_summary_count)) {
    
    pi <- healthy_layer_props %>%
      filter(Tier2 == i) %>%
      select(layer, p_i = p)
    
    pj <- dss9_layer_props %>%
      filter(Tier2 == j) %>%
      select(layer, p_j = p)
    
    pp <- full_join(pi, pj, by = "layer") %>%
      mutate(
        p_i = tidyr::replace_na(p_i, 0),
        p_j = tidyr::replace_na(p_j, 0)
      )
    
    layer_distribution_overlap[i, j] <- sum(sqrt(pp$p_i * pp$p_j))
  }
}

# Apply optional sharpening
layer_distribution_overlap_gamma <- layer_distribution_overlap ^ gamma

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Final mixture-aware composite similarity
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# If gamma = 1:
#   S_final_mixture_aware = S_summary_count * layer_distribution_overlap
#
# If gamma > 1:
#   partial layer-composition mismatch is penalized more strongly.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

S_final_mixture_aware <- S_summary_count * layer_distribution_overlap_gamma

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Save outputs
# ------------------------------------------------------------

write_csv(
  as.data.frame(S_summary_count) %>%
    rownames_to_column("Healthy_Tier2"),
  file.path(outdir, "Healthy_vs_DSS9_step2_weighted_summary_similarity.csv")
)

write_csv(
  as.data.frame(layer_distribution_overlap) %>%
    rownames_to_column("Healthy_Tier2"),
  file.path(outdir, "Healthy_vs_DSS9_step3_layer_distribution_overlap_filtered_gt30.csv")
)

write_csv(
  as.data.frame(layer_distribution_overlap_gamma) %>%
    rownames_to_column("Healthy_Tier2"),
  file.path(
    outdir,
    paste0("Healthy_vs_DSS9_step3_layer_distribution_overlap_filtered_gt30_gamma_", gamma, ".csv")
  )
)

write_csv(
  as.data.frame(S_final_mixture_aware) %>%
    rownames_to_column("Healthy_Tier2"),
  file.path(
    outdir,
    paste0("Healthy_vs_DSS9_final_mixture_aware_filtered_gt30_gamma_", gamma, ".csv")
  )
)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Reorder rows and columns by Tier1 class
# ============================================================
# Rows are Healthy Tier2 cell types.

# in the MorphoGAM xyt files.

read_all_xyt <- function(prefix) {

      Tier1 = as.character(Tier1),

}

healthy_xyt_all <- read_all_xyt("Healthy")
dss9_xyt_all    <- read_all_xyt("DSS9")

tier1_order <- bind_rows(

healthy_tier_map <- healthy_xyt_all %>%

dss9_tier_map <- dss9_xyt_all %>%
  count(Tier2, Tier1, name = "n") %>%
  group_by(Tier2) %>%
  slice_max(n, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(Tier2, Tier1)

row_order <- healthy_tier_map %>%
  filter(Tier2 %in% rownames(S_final_mixture_aware)) %>%
  mutate(Tier1 = factor(Tier1, levels = tier1_order)) %>%
  arrange(Tier1, Tier2) %>%
  pull(Tier2)

col_order <- dss9_tier_map %>%
  filter(Tier2 %in% colnames(S_final_mixture_aware)) %>%
  mutate(Tier1 = factor(Tier1, levels = tier1_order)) %>%
  arrange(Tier1, Tier2) %>%
  pull(Tier2)

row_order <- c(row_order, setdiff(rownames(S_final_mixture_aware), row_order))
col_order <- c(col_order, setdiff(colnames(S_final_mixture_aware), col_order))

S_summary_count_ordered <- S_summary_count[
  row_order,

  drop = FALSE
]

cell_weight_sum_ordered <- cell_weight_sum[

  drop = FALSE
]

layer_coverage_count_ordered <- layer_coverage_count[
  row_order,
  col_order,
  drop = FALSE
]

layer_distribution_overlap_ordered <- layer_distribution_overlap[
  row_order,
  col_order,
  drop = FALSE
]

S_final_mixture_aware_ordered <- S_final_mixture_aware[
  row_order,
  col_order,
  drop = FALSE
]

write_csv(
  as.data.frame(S_summary_count_ordered) %>%
    rownames_to_column("Healthy_Tier2"),
  file.path(outdir, "Healthy_vs_DSS9_step2_weighted_summary_similarity_Tier1_ordered.csv")
)

write_csv(
  as.data.frame(layer_distribution_overlap_ordered) %>%
    rownames_to_column("Healthy_Tier2"),
  file.path(outdir, "Healthy_vs_DSS9_step3_layer_distribution_overlap_unfiltered_Tier1_ordered.csv")
)

write_csv(
  as.data.frame(S_final_mixture_aware_ordered) %>%
    rownames_to_column("Healthy_Tier2"),

)

write_csv(
```

## Check known fibroblast transitions

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Check known / expected fibroblast transitions
# ============================================================
# Based on the paper:
#   Fibro 2 -> IAF 4
#   Fibro 6 -> IAF 2 / IAF 3
#   Fibro 7 -> Fibro 4
#
# Here we report:
#   1. Step 2 weighted-summary similarity
#   2. Step 3 layer-distribution overlap
#   3. Final mixture-aware similarity
#   4. Rank among all DSS9 Tier2 cell types
# ============================================================

ground_truth_pairs <- tibble::tribble(
  ~Healthy_Tier2, ~DSS9_Tier2,
  "Fibro 2",      "IAF 4",
  "Fibro 6",      "IAF 2",
  "Fibro 6",      "IAF 3",
  "Fibro 7",      "Fibro 4"
)

pull_matrix_value <- function(mat, row_name, col_name) {
  if (row_name %in% rownames(mat) && col_name %in% colnames(mat)) {
    as.numeric(mat[row_name, col_name])
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }
}

get_rank_for_pair <- function(healthy_tier2, dss9_tier2, S_mat) {
  
  if (!(healthy_tier2 %in% rownames(S_mat))) return(NA_real_)
  
  rank_table <- tibble(
    DSS9_Tier2 = colnames(S_mat),
    similarity = as.numeric(S_mat[healthy_tier2, ])
  ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(similarity)) %>%
    arrange(desc(similarity)) %>%
    mutate(rank = row_number())
  
  out <- rank_table %>%
    filter(DSS9_Tier2 == dss9_tier2)
  
  if (nrow(out) == 0) NA_real_ else out$rank[1]
}

ground_truth_mixture_check <- ground_truth_pairs %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    step2_weighted_summary_similarity = pull_matrix_value(
      S_summary_count_ordered,
      Healthy_Tier2,
      DSS9_Tier2
    ),
    step3_layer_distribution_overlap = pull_matrix_value(
      layer_distribution_overlap_ordered,
      Healthy_Tier2,
      DSS9_Tier2
    ),
    final_mixture_aware_similarity = pull_matrix_value(
      S_final_mixture_aware_ordered,
      Healthy_Tier2,
      DSS9_Tier2
    ),
    total_cell_weight = pull_matrix_value(
      cell_weight_sum_ordered,
      Healthy_Tier2,
      DSS9_Tier2
    ),
    layer_coverage = pull_matrix_value(
      layer_coverage_count_ordered,
      Healthy_Tier2,
      DSS9_Tier2
    ),
    rank_among_DSS9_final = get_rank_for_pair(
      Healthy_Tier2,
      DSS9_Tier2,
      S_final_mixture_aware_ordered
    ),
    rank_among_DSS9_step2_only = get_rank_for_pair(
      Healthy_Tier2,
      DSS9_Tier2,
      S_summary_count_ordered
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

ground_truth_mixture_check

write_csv(
  ground_truth_mixture_check,
  file.path(outdir, "ground_truth_mixture_aware_check.csv")
)
```

# Benchmarking
## Day0 vs Day0 benchmark

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Day0 vs Day0 benchmark
# ============================================================
# Goal:
# Test whether the mixture-aware spatial similarity method can
# recover self-matches after splitting Healthy Day0 cells into
# two pseudo-replicates.
#
# Important:
# This benchmark uses Healthy_xyt_mapped_MU/SM/ME.csv.
# These files should already come from the >30 cells per
# Tier2-per-layer filtered data used for MorphoGAM.
#
# Benchmark logic:
#   1. Split Healthy cells into Day0_A and Day0_B.
#   2. Compute layer-specific JSD similarity within MU / SM / ME.
#   3. Summarize layer-specific similarities using cell-count weights.
#   4. Apply layer-distribution overlap correction.
#   5. Check whether each Day0_A Tier2 best matches the same Day0_B Tier2.
# ============================================================

set.seed(123)

layers <- c("MU", "SM", "ME")
min_cells <- 30
gamma_day0 <- 1   # gamma = 1 no sharpening; gamma = 2 sharper layer-overlap penalty

# ============================================================
# 1. Read Healthy MorphoGAM-mapped cells
# ============================================================

read_xyt_layers <- function(prefix, layers = c("MU", "SM", "ME")) {
  
  bind_rows(lapply(layers, function(ly) {
    read_csv(
      file.path(outdir, paste0(prefix, "_xyt_mapped_", ly, ".csv")),
      show_col_types = FALSE
    )
  })) %>%
    mutate(
      layer = as.character(layer),
      Tier1 = as.character(Tier1),
      Tier2 = as.character(Tier2),
      r_for_jsd = as.numeric(r_for_jsd)
    ) %>%
    filter(
      layer %in% layers,
      !is.na(Tier1),
      !is.na(Tier2),
      is.finite(r_for_jsd),
      r_for_jsd >= 0,
      r_for_jsd <= 1
    )
}

healthy_xyt_benchmark <- read_xyt_layers("Healthy", layers)

# Optional check: confirm retained layer-Tier2 combinations are >30
healthy_xyt_benchmark %>%
  count(layer, Tier2, name = "n_cells") %>%
  summarise(
    min_n_cells = min(n_cells),
    n_layer_tier2_combinations = n()
  )

# ============================================================
# 2. Split Healthy Day0 into two pseudo-replicates
# ============================================================
# Prefer splitting by Slice_ID if multiple slices are available.
# If only one slice is available, use random cell split.
# ============================================================

if ("Slice_ID" %in% colnames(healthy_xyt_benchmark) &&
    length(unique(healthy_xyt_benchmark$Slice_ID)) >= 2) {
  
  slice_split <- tibble(
    Slice_ID = unique(healthy_xyt_benchmark$Slice_ID),
    benchmark_group = sample(
      rep(c("Day0_A", "Day0_B"),
          length.out = length(unique(healthy_xyt_benchmark$Slice_ID)))
    )
  )
  
  healthy_xyt_benchmark <- healthy_xyt_benchmark %>%
    left_join(slice_split, by = "Slice_ID")
  
} else {
  
  healthy_xyt_benchmark <- healthy_xyt_benchmark %>%
    mutate(
      benchmark_group = sample(
        c("Day0_A", "Day0_B"),
        size = n(),
        replace = TRUE
      )
    )
}

table(healthy_xyt_benchmark$benchmark_group)

# ============================================================
# 3. Layer-specific JSD similarity: Day0_A vs Day0_B
# ============================================================

compute_benchmark_layer_jsd <- function(layer_name,
                                        coord = "r_for_jsd",
                                        min_cells = 30,
                                        plot_heatmap = FALSE) {
  
  message("Computing Day0_A vs Day0_B for layer: ", layer_name)
  
  dA <- healthy_xyt_benchmark %>%
    filter(layer == layer_name, benchmark_group == "Day0_A") %>%
    clean_xyt(coord = coord)
  
  dB <- healthy_xyt_benchmark %>%
    filter(layer == layer_name, benchmark_group == "Day0_B") %>%
    clean_xyt(coord = coord)
  
  keep_A <- dA %>%
    count(Tier2, name = "n_A") %>%
    filter(n_A > min_cells)
  
  keep_B <- dB %>%
    count(Tier2, name = "n_B") %>%
    filter(n_B > min_cells)
  
  dA <- dA %>% semi_join(keep_A, by = "Tier2")
  dB <- dB %>% semi_join(keep_B, by = "Tier2")
  
  rows <- sort(unique(dA$Tier2))
  cols <- sort(unique(dB$Tier2))
  
  rA_list <- split(dA$value, dA$Tier2)
  rB_list <- split(dB$value, dB$Tier2)
  
  bw_global <- bw.nrd0(c(dA$value, dB$value))
  
  if (!is.finite(bw_global) || bw_global <= 0) {
    bw_global <- 0.05
  }
  
  D <- matrix(
    NA_real_,
    nrow = length(rows),
    ncol = length(cols),
    dimnames = list(rows, cols)
  )
  
  for (i in seq_along(rows)) {
    for (j in seq_along(cols)) {
      D[i, j] <- js_dist_kde(
        rA_list[[rows[i]]],
        rB_list[[cols[j]]],
        bw = bw_global
      )
    }
  }
  
  sigma <- as.numeric(quantile(D, 0.5, na.rm = TRUE))
  
  if (!is.finite(sigma) || sigma <= 0) {
    sigma <- mean(D[is.finite(D)], na.rm = TRUE)
  }
  
  if (!is.finite(sigma) || sigma <= 0) {
    sigma <- 1
  }
  
  S <- exp(-D / sigma)
  
  if (plot_heatmap) {
    finite_vals <- S[is.finite(S)]
    
    if (length(unique(round(finite_vals, 8))) > 1) {
      pheatmap(
        S,
        cluster_rows = FALSE,
        cluster_cols = FALSE,
        main = paste0("Day0_A vs Day0_B ", layer_name, " spatial similarity"),
        fontsize_row = 7,
        fontsize_col = 7
      )
    }
  }
  
  list(
    D = D,
    S = S,
    bw_global = bw_global,
    sigma = sigma,
    layer = layer_name
  )
}

day0_jsd_list <- setNames(
  lapply(layers, function(ly) {
    compute_benchmark_layer_jsd(
      layer_name = ly,
      coord = "r_for_jsd",
      min_cells = min_cells,
      plot_heatmap = FALSE
    )
  }),
  layers
)

# ============================================================
# 4. Step 2: cell-count weighted summary across layers
# ============================================================

get_benchmark_counts <- function(group_name) {
  
  healthy_xyt_benchmark %>%
    filter(benchmark_group == group_name) %>%
    count(layer, Tier2, name = "n") %>%
    mutate(
      layer = as.character(layer),
      Tier2 = as.character(Tier2)
    )
}

day0_A_counts <- get_benchmark_counts("Day0_A")
day0_B_counts <- get_benchmark_counts("Day0_B")

all_rows_day0 <- sort(unique(unlist(lapply(day0_jsd_list, function(x) rownames(x$S)))))
all_cols_day0 <- sort(unique(unlist(lapply(day0_jsd_list, function(x) colnames(x$S)))))

S_num_day0 <- matrix(
  0,
  nrow = length(all_rows_day0),
  ncol = length(all_cols_day0),
  dimnames = list(all_rows_day0, all_cols_day0)
)

S_den_day0 <- matrix(
  0,
  nrow = length(all_rows_day0),
  ncol = length(all_cols_day0),
  dimnames = list(all_rows_day0, all_cols_day0)
)

layer_coverage_day0 <- matrix(
  0,
  nrow = length(all_rows_day0),
  ncol = length(all_cols_day0),
  dimnames = list(all_rows_day0, all_cols_day0)
)

cell_weight_sum_day0 <- matrix(
  0,
  nrow = length(all_rows_day0),
  ncol = length(all_cols_day0),
  dimnames = list(all_rows_day0, all_cols_day0)
)

for (ly in layers) {
  
  S_layer <- day0_jsd_list[[ly]]$S
  
  nA_layer <- day0_A_counts %>% filter(layer == ly)
  nB_layer <- day0_B_counts %>% filter(layer == ly)
  
  for (i in rownames(S_layer)) {
    for (j in colnames(S_layer)) {
      
      sij <- S_layer[i, j]
      if (!is.finite(sij)) next
      
      n_i <- nA_layer %>% filter(Tier2 == i) %>% pull(n)
      n_j <- nB_layer %>% filter(Tier2 == j) %>% pull(n)
      
      if (length(n_i) == 0 || length(n_j) == 0) next
      
      w <- sqrt(n_i * n_j)
      if (!is.finite(w) || w <= 0) next
      
      S_num_day0[i, j] <- S_num_day0[i, j] + w * sij
      S_den_day0[i, j] <- S_den_day0[i, j] + w
      layer_coverage_day0[i, j] <- layer_coverage_day0[i, j] + 1
      cell_weight_sum_day0[i, j] <- cell_weight_sum_day0[i, j] + w
    }
  }
}

S_day0_summary <- S_num_day0 / S_den_day0
S_day0_summary[S_den_day0 == 0] <- NA

# ============================================================
# 5. Step 3: anatomical layer-distribution overlap
# ============================================================

get_layer_props <- function(count_df) {
  
  count_df %>%
    group_by(Tier2) %>%
    mutate(
      total_n = sum(n),
      p = n / total_n
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(Tier2, layer, n, total_n, p)
}

day0_A_layer_props <- get_layer_props(day0_A_counts)
day0_B_layer_props <- get_layer_props(day0_B_counts)

layer_distribution_overlap_day0 <- matrix(
  NA_real_,
  nrow = nrow(S_day0_summary),
  ncol = ncol(S_day0_summary),
  dimnames = dimnames(S_day0_summary)
)

for (i in rownames(S_day0_summary)) {
  for (j in colnames(S_day0_summary)) {
    
    pi <- day0_A_layer_props %>%
      filter(Tier2 == i) %>%
      select(layer, p_i = p)
    
    pj <- day0_B_layer_props %>%
      filter(Tier2 == j) %>%
      select(layer, p_j = p)
    
    pp <- full_join(pi, pj, by = "layer") %>%
      mutate(
        p_i = tidyr::replace_na(p_i, 0),
        p_j = tidyr::replace_na(p_j, 0)
      )
    
    layer_distribution_overlap_day0[i, j] <- sum(sqrt(pp$p_i * pp$p_j))
  }
}

layer_distribution_overlap_day0_gamma <- layer_distribution_overlap_day0 ^ gamma_day0

S_day0_final_mixture_aware <- S_day0_summary * layer_distribution_overlap_day0_gamma

# ============================================================
# 6. Reorder by Tier1 class
# ============================================================

make_tier_map <- function(group_name) {
  
  healthy_xyt_benchmark %>%
    filter(benchmark_group == group_name) %>%
    count(Tier2, Tier1, name = "n") %>%
    group_by(Tier2) %>%
    slice_max(n, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(Tier2, Tier1)
}

tier_map_A_day0 <- make_tier_map("Day0_A")
tier_map_B_day0 <- make_tier_map("Day0_B")

tier1_order_day0 <- bind_rows(
  tier_map_A_day0 %>% select(Tier1),
  tier_map_B_day0 %>% select(Tier1)
) %>%
  distinct(Tier1) %>%
  pull(Tier1)

row_order_day0 <- tier_map_A_day0 %>%
  filter(Tier2 %in% rownames(S_day0_final_mixture_aware)) %>%
  mutate(Tier1 = factor(Tier1, levels = tier1_order_day0)) %>%
  arrange(Tier1, Tier2) %>%
  pull(Tier2)

col_order_day0 <- tier_map_B_day0 %>%
  filter(Tier2 %in% colnames(S_day0_final_mixture_aware)) %>%
  mutate(Tier1 = factor(Tier1, levels = tier1_order_day0)) %>%
  arrange(Tier1, Tier2) %>%
  pull(Tier2)

row_order_day0 <- c(row_order_day0, setdiff(rownames(S_day0_final_mixture_aware), row_order_day0))
col_order_day0 <- c(col_order_day0, setdiff(colnames(S_day0_final_mixture_aware), col_order_day0))

order_day0_matrix <- function(mat) {
  mat[row_order_day0, col_order_day0, drop = FALSE]
}

S_day0_summary_ordered <- order_day0_matrix(S_day0_summary)
layer_distribution_overlap_day0_ordered <- order_day0_matrix(layer_distribution_overlap_day0)
S_day0_final_mixture_aware_ordered <- order_day0_matrix(S_day0_final_mixture_aware)
cell_weight_sum_day0_ordered <- order_day0_matrix(cell_weight_sum_day0)
layer_coverage_day0_ordered <- order_day0_matrix(layer_coverage_day0)

# ============================================================
# 7. Plot Day0-vs-Day0 heatmap
# ============================================================

row_annotation_day0 <- tier_map_A_day0 %>%
  filter(Tier2 %in% rownames(S_day0_final_mixture_aware_ordered)) %>%
  distinct(Tier2, Tier1) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("Tier2")

row_annotation_day0 <- row_annotation_day0[
  rownames(S_day0_final_mixture_aware_ordered),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

col_annotation_day0 <- tier_map_B_day0 %>%
  filter(Tier2 %in% colnames(S_day0_final_mixture_aware_ordered)) %>%
  distinct(Tier2, Tier1) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("Tier2")

col_annotation_day0 <- col_annotation_day0[
  colnames(S_day0_final_mixture_aware_ordered),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

all_tier1_day0 <- unique(c(row_annotation_day0$Tier1, col_annotation_day0$Tier1))

tier1_palette_day0 <- colorRampPalette(
  brewer.pal(min(8, max(3, length(all_tier1_day0))), "Set2")
)(length(all_tier1_day0))

annotation_colors_day0 <- list(
  Tier1 = setNames(tier1_palette_day0, all_tier1_day0)

get_gaps <- function(annotation_df) {
  tier1_vec <- as.character(annotation_df$Tier1)
  which(tier1_vec[-1] != tier1_vec[-length(tier1_vec)])
}

row_gaps_day0 <- get_gaps(row_annotation_day0)
col_gaps_day0 <- get_gaps(col_annotation_day0)

heat_cols <- colorRampPalette(c("white", "gold", "red"))(100)

pheatmap(
  S_day0_final_mixture_aware_ordered,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  annotation_row = row_annotation_day0,
  annotation_col = col_annotation_day0,
  annotation_colors = annotation_colors_day0,
  gaps_row = row_gaps_day0,

  fontsize_row = 6,
  fontsize_col = 6,
  angle_col = 45,
  annotation_names_row = TRUE,
  annotation_names_col = TRUE
)

# ============================================================
# 8. Self-match diagnostics
# ============================================================

get_self_match_benchmark <- function(S_mat) {
  
  bind_rows(lapply(rownames(S_mat), function(i) {
    
    vals <- S_mat[i, ]
    
    rank_table <- tibble(
      Day0_B_Tier2 = colnames(S_mat),
      similarity = as.numeric(vals)
    ) %>%
      filter(is.finite(similarity)) %>%
      arrange(desc(similarity)) %>%
      mutate(rank = row_number())
    
    self_row <- rank_table %>%
      filter(Day0_B_Tier2 == i)
    
    tibble(
      Day0_A_Tier2 = i,
      top_Day0_B_Tier2 = rank_table$Day0_B_Tier2[1],
      top_similarity = rank_table$similarity[1],
      self_similarity = if (nrow(self_row) == 0) NA_real_ else self_row$similarity[1],
      self_rank = if (nrow(self_row) == 0) NA_integer_ else self_row$rank[1],
      self_is_top1 = if (nrow(self_row) == 0) FALSE else self_row$rank[1] == 1
    )
  }))
}

day0_self_match_benchmark <- get_self_match_benchmark(
  S_day0_final_mixture_aware_ordered
)

day0_self_match_benchmark %>%
  arrange(self_rank, desc(self_similarity))

benchmark_summary <- day0_self_match_benchmark %>%
  summarise(
    n_cell_types = n(),
    n_self_top1 = sum(self_is_top1, na.rm = TRUE),
    prop_self_top1 = mean(self_is_top1, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_self_rank = median(self_rank, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_self_similarity = mean(self_similarity, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Crypt base-to-tip epithelial lineage sanity check
# ============================================================
# Biological expectation:
#   Stem cells -> TA -> Colonocytes
#
# Spatial expectation:
#   crypt base: Stem cells, Goblet 1
#   intermediate: TA
#   crypt tip: Colonocytes, Goblet 2
#
# This table checks whether expected self-matches and nearby
# crypt-axis relationships are recovered in the Day0-vs-Day0
# benchmark.
# ============================================================

crypt_lineage_pairs <- tibble::tribble(
  ~Day0_A_Tier2, ~Day0_B_Tier2, ~expected_relationship,
  "Stem cells",  "Stem cells",  "self-match; crypt base",
  "TA",          "TA",          "self-match; transit-amplifying",
  "Colonocytes", "Colonocytes", "self-match; crypt tip / mature epithelial",
  "Goblet 1",    "Goblet 1",    "self-match; crypt base-associated",
  "Goblet 2",    "Goblet 2",    "self-match; crypt tip-associated",
  
  "Stem cells",  "TA",          "adjacent along crypt base-to-tip axis",
  "TA",          "Colonocytes", "adjacent along crypt base-to-tip axis",
  "Stem cells",  "Colonocytes", "same lineage but farther apart",
  
  "Goblet 1",    "Stem cells",  "both crypt-base associated",
  "Goblet 1",    "TA",          "base-to-intermediate relationship",
  "Goblet 2",    "Colonocytes", "both crypt-tip associated",
  "Goblet 2",    "TA",          "tip-to-intermediate relationship"
)

pull_matrix_value <- function(mat, row_name, col_name) {
  if (row_name %in% rownames(mat) && col_name %in% colnames(mat)) {
    as.numeric(mat[row_name, col_name])
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }
}

get_rank_for_pair_day0 <- function(day0_A_tier2, day0_B_tier2, S_mat) {
  
  if (!(day0_A_tier2 %in% rownames(S_mat))) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  
  rank_table <- tibble(
    Day0_B_Tier2 = colnames(S_mat),
    similarity = as.numeric(S_mat[day0_A_tier2, ])
  ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(similarity)) %>%
    arrange(desc(similarity)) %>%
    mutate(rank = row_number())
  
  out <- rank_table %>%
    filter(Day0_B_Tier2 == day0_B_tier2)
  
  if (nrow(out) == 0) NA_real_ else out$rank[1]
}

get_top_matches_day0 <- function(day0_A_tier2, S_mat, top_n = 5) {
  
  if (!(day0_A_tier2 %in% rownames(S_mat))) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }
  
  tibble(
    Day0_B_Tier2 = colnames(S_mat),
    similarity = as.numeric(S_mat[day0_A_tier2, ])
  ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(similarity)) %>%
    arrange(desc(similarity)) %>%
    slice_head(n = top_n) %>%
    mutate(label = paste0(Day0_B_Tier2, " (", round(similarity, 3), ")")) %>%
    pull(label) %>%
    paste(collapse = "; ")
}

crypt_lineage_sanity_check <- crypt_lineage_pairs %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    step2_weighted_summary_similarity = pull_matrix_value(
      S_day0_summary_ordered,
      Day0_A_Tier2,
      Day0_B_Tier2
    ),
    layer_distribution_overlap = pull_matrix_value(
      layer_distribution_overlap_day0_ordered,
      Day0_A_Tier2,
      Day0_B_Tier2
    ),
    final_mixture_aware_similarity = pull_matrix_value(
      S_day0_final_mixture_aware_ordered,
      Day0_A_Tier2,
      Day0_B_Tier2
    ),
    rank_among_Day0_B = get_rank_for_pair_day0(
      Day0_A_Tier2,
      Day0_B_Tier2,
      S_day0_final_mixture_aware_ordered
    ),
    top5_Day0_B_matches_for_Day0_A = get_top_matches_day0(
      Day0_A_Tier2,
      S_day0_final_mixture_aware_ordered,
      top_n = 5
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

crypt_lineage_sanity_check
```

## Epi
```{r}
# ============================================================
# Epi: Day0 vs Day0 epithelial-only benchmark
# Revised version:
#   1. Uses epithelial Tier1 only
#   2. Uses stratified split within layer × Tier2
#   3. Uses lower post-split threshold because input xyt files
#      were already filtered before MorphoGAM
#   4. Shows heatmap numbers
#   5. Reports ground-truth rank as rank / total candidates
# ============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(readr)
library(pheatmap)
library(RColorBrewer)

set.seed(123)

# ============================================================
# Fine-tuning parameters
# ============================================================

layers <- c("MU", "SM", "ME")

# Because xyt files were already generated after >30 layer-Tier2 filtering,
# use a lower threshold after splitting into pseudo-replicates.
min_cells_epi <- 15

gamma_epi_day0 <- 1

use_only_MU_for_epi <- FALSE

if (use_only_MU_for_epi) {
  layers_epi <- "MU"
} else {
  layers_epi <- layers
}

# ============================================================
# Helper functions
# ============================================================

safe_pheatmap <- function(mat,
                          main,
                          color,
                          show_numbers = TRUE,
                          number_format = "%.2f",
                          fontsize_number = 7,
                          cellwidth = 38,
                          cellheight = 28,
                          ...) {
  
  finite_vals <- mat[is.finite(mat)]
  
  if (length(finite_vals) == 0) {
    message("Skipping heatmap: ", main, " has no finite values.")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  if (length(unique(round(finite_vals, 8))) < 2) {
    message(
      "Skipping heatmap: ", main,
      " has only one unique finite value: ",
      unique(round(finite_vals, 8))[1]
    )
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  pheatmap(
    mat,
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    cluster_cols = FALSE,
    color = color,
    border_color = NA,
    main = main,
    display_numbers = show_numbers,
    number_format = number_format,
    fontsize_number = fontsize_number,
    cellwidth = cellwidth,
    cellheight = cellheight,
    ...
  )
}

is_epithelial_tier1 <- function(x) {
  grepl("epi", x, ignore.case = TRUE)
}

expected_epi_order <- c(
  "Stem cells",
  "TA",
  "Colonocytes",
  "Goblet 1",
  "Goblet 2",
  "EEC",
  "M cells",
  "Clu+ epithelia",
  "IAE1",
  "IAE2",
  "IAE3",
  "Repair-associated"
)

order_epi_matrix <- function(mat) {
  
  row_order <- c(
    intersect(expected_epi_order, rownames(mat)),
    setdiff(rownames(mat), expected_epi_order)
  )
  
  col_order <- c(
    intersect(expected_epi_order, colnames(mat)),
    setdiff(colnames(mat), expected_epi_order)
  )
  
  mat[row_order, col_order, drop = FALSE]
}

pull_matrix_value_epi <- function(mat, row_name, col_name) {
  if (row_name %in% rownames(mat) && col_name %in% colnames(mat)) {
    as.numeric(mat[row_name, col_name])
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }
}

get_rank_for_pair_epi <- function(row_name, col_name, S_mat) {
  
  if (!(row_name %in% rownames(S_mat))) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  
  rank_table <- tibble(
    Day0_B_Tier2 = colnames(S_mat),
    similarity = as.numeric(S_mat[row_name, ])
  ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(similarity)) %>%
    arrange(desc(similarity)) %>%
    mutate(rank = row_number())
  
  out <- rank_table %>%
    filter(Day0_B_Tier2 == col_name)
  
  if (nrow(out) == 0) NA_real_ else out$rank[1]
}

get_top_matches_epi <- function(row_name, S_mat, top_n = 5) {
  
  if (!(row_name %in% rownames(S_mat))) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }
  
  tibble(
    Day0_B_Tier2 = colnames(S_mat),
    similarity = as.numeric(S_mat[row_name, ])
  ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(similarity)) %>%
    arrange(desc(similarity)) %>%
    slice_head(n = top_n) %>%
    mutate(label = paste0(Day0_B_Tier2, " (", round(similarity, 3), ")")) %>%
    pull(label) %>%
    paste(collapse = "; ")
}

get_epi_layer_props <- function(count_df) {
  
  count_df %>%
    group_by(Tier2) %>%
    mutate(
      total_n = sum(n),
      p = n / total_n
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(Tier2, layer, n, total_n, p)
}

# ============================================================
# 1. Read Healthy MorphoGAM-mapped cells and keep epithelial only
# ============================================================

read_xyt_layers_epi <- function(prefix, layers = c("MU", "SM", "ME")) {
  
  bind_rows(lapply(layers, function(ly) {
    read_csv(
      file.path(outdir, paste0(prefix, "_xyt_mapped_", ly, ".csv")),
      show_col_types = FALSE
    )
  })) %>%
    mutate(
      layer = as.character(layer),
      Tier1 = as.character(Tier1),
      Tier2 = as.character(Tier2),
      r_for_jsd = as.numeric(r_for_jsd)
    ) %>%
    filter(
      layer %in% layers,
      !is.na(Tier1),
      !is.na(Tier2),
      is_epithelial_tier1(Tier1),
      is.finite(r_for_jsd),
      r_for_jsd >= 0,
      r_for_jsd <= 1
    )
}

healthy_epi_benchmark <- read_xyt_layers_epi("Healthy", layers_epi)

healthy_epi_benchmark %>%
  count(layer, Tier2, name = "n_cells") %>%
  arrange(layer, desc(n_cells))

healthy_epi_benchmark %>%
  count(Tier2, name = "total_cells") %>%
  arrange(desc(total_cells))

# ============================================================
# 2. Stratified split within layer × Tier2
# ============================================================
# This creates balanced Day0_A and Day0_B pseudo-replicates
# for each retained layer-cell type combination.
# ============================================================

healthy_epi_benchmark <- healthy_epi_benchmark %>%
  group_by(layer, Tier2) %>%
  mutate(
    benchmark_group = sample(
      rep(c("Day0_A", "Day0_B"), length.out = n())
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

table(healthy_epi_benchmark$benchmark_group)

healthy_epi_benchmark %>%
  count(layer, Tier2, benchmark_group, name = "n_cells") %>%
  arrange(layer, Tier2, benchmark_group)

# ============================================================
# 3. Step 1: Layer-specific JSD similarity
# ============================================================

compute_epi_benchmark_layer_jsd <- function(layer_name,
                                            coord = "r_for_jsd",
                                            min_cells = 15,
                                            plot_heatmap = TRUE) {
  
  message("Computing epithelial Day0_A vs Day0_B for layer: ", layer_name)
  
  dA <- healthy_epi_benchmark %>%
    filter(layer == layer_name, benchmark_group == "Day0_A") %>%
    clean_xyt(coord = coord)
  
  dB <- healthy_epi_benchmark %>%
    filter(layer == layer_name, benchmark_group == "Day0_B") %>%
    clean_xyt(coord = coord)
  
  keep_A <- dA %>%
    count(Tier2, name = "n_A") %>%
    filter(n_A >= min_cells)
  
  keep_B <- dB %>%
    count(Tier2, name = "n_B") %>%
    filter(n_B >= min_cells)
  
  dA <- dA %>% semi_join(keep_A, by = "Tier2")
  dB <- dB %>% semi_join(keep_B, by = "Tier2")
  
  rows <- sort(unique(dA$Tier2))
  cols <- sort(unique(dB$Tier2))
  
  D <- matrix(
    NA_real_,
    nrow = length(rows),
    ncol = length(cols),
    dimnames = list(rows, cols)
  )
  
  if (length(rows) == 0 || length(cols) == 0) {
    message("No valid epithelial Tier2 after min_cells filter in layer: ", layer_name)
    return(list(
      D = D,
      S = D,
      bw_global = NA_real_,
      sigma = NA_real_,
      layer = layer_name
    ))
  }
  
  rA_list <- split(dA$value, dA$Tier2)
  rB_list <- split(dB$value, dB$Tier2)
  
  bw_global <- bw.nrd0(c(dA$value, dB$value))
  
  if (!is.finite(bw_global) || bw_global <= 0) {
    bw_global <- 0.05
  }
  
  for (i in seq_along(rows)) {
    for (j in seq_along(cols)) {
      D[i, j] <- js_dist_kde(
        rA_list[[rows[i]]],
        rB_list[[cols[j]]],
        bw = bw_global
      )
    }
  }
  
  sigma <- as.numeric(quantile(D, 0.5, na.rm = TRUE))
  
  if (!is.finite(sigma) || sigma <= 0) {
    sigma <- mean(D[is.finite(D)], na.rm = TRUE)
  }
  
  if (!is.finite(sigma) || sigma <= 0) {
    sigma <- 1
  }
  
  S <- exp(-D / sigma)
  
  if (plot_heatmap) {
    safe_pheatmap(
      order_epi_matrix(S),
      main = paste0("Step 1: epithelial Day0_A vs Day0_B ", layer_name),
      color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "gold", "red"))(100),
      show_numbers = TRUE,
      number_format = "%.2f",
      fontsize_number = 7,
      fontsize_row = 9,
      fontsize_col = 9,
      angle_col = 45
    )
  }
  
  list(
    D = D,
    S = S,
    bw_global = bw_global,
    sigma = sigma,
    layer = layer_name
  )
}

epi_day0_jsd_list <- setNames(
  lapply(layers_epi, function(ly) {
    compute_epi_benchmark_layer_jsd(
      layer_name = ly,
      coord = "r_for_jsd",
      min_cells = min_cells_epi,
      plot_heatmap = TRUE
    )
  }),
  layers_epi
)

# ============================================================
# 4. Step 2: Cell-count-weighted summary across layers
# ============================================================

epi_day0_A_counts <- healthy_epi_benchmark %>%
  filter(benchmark_group == "Day0_A") %>%
  count(layer, Tier2, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(layer = as.character(layer), Tier2 = as.character(Tier2))

epi_day0_B_counts <- healthy_epi_benchmark %>%
  filter(benchmark_group == "Day0_B") %>%
  count(layer, Tier2, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(layer = as.character(layer), Tier2 = as.character(Tier2))

all_rows_epi_day0 <- sort(unique(unlist(lapply(epi_day0_jsd_list, function(x) rownames(x$S)))))
all_cols_epi_day0 <- sort(unique(unlist(lapply(epi_day0_jsd_list, function(x) colnames(x$S)))))

S_num_epi_day0 <- matrix(0, length(all_rows_epi_day0), length(all_cols_epi_day0),
                         dimnames = list(all_rows_epi_day0, all_cols_epi_day0))
S_den_epi_day0 <- matrix(0, length(all_rows_epi_day0), length(all_cols_epi_day0),
                         dimnames = list(all_rows_epi_day0, all_cols_epi_day0))
layer_coverage_epi_day0 <- matrix(0, length(all_rows_epi_day0), length(all_cols_epi_day0),
                                  dimnames = list(all_rows_epi_day0, all_cols_epi_day0))
cell_weight_sum_epi_day0 <- matrix(0, length(all_rows_epi_day0), length(all_cols_epi_day0),
                                   dimnames = list(all_rows_epi_day0, all_cols_epi_day0))

for (ly in layers_epi) {
  
  S_layer <- epi_day0_jsd_list[[ly]]$S
  
  nA_layer <- epi_day0_A_counts %>% filter(layer == ly)
  nB_layer <- epi_day0_B_counts %>% filter(layer == ly)
  
  for (i in rownames(S_layer)) {
    for (j in colnames(S_layer)) {
      
      sij <- S_layer[i, j]
      if (!is.finite(sij)) next
      
      n_i <- nA_layer %>% filter(Tier2 == i) %>% pull(n)
      n_j <- nB_layer %>% filter(Tier2 == j) %>% pull(n)
      
      if (length(n_i) == 0 || length(n_j) == 0) next
      
      w <- sqrt(n_i * n_j)
      if (!is.finite(w) || w <= 0) next
      
      S_num_epi_day0[i, j] <- S_num_epi_day0[i, j] + w * sij
      S_den_epi_day0[i, j] <- S_den_epi_day0[i, j] + w
      layer_coverage_epi_day0[i, j] <- layer_coverage_epi_day0[i, j] + 1
      cell_weight_sum_epi_day0[i, j] <- cell_weight_sum_epi_day0[i, j] + w
    }
  }
}

S_epi_day0_summary <- S_num_epi_day0 / S_den_epi_day0
S_epi_day0_summary[S_den_epi_day0 == 0] <- NA

# ============================================================
# 5. Step 3: Anatomical layer-distribution overlap
# ============================================================

epi_day0_A_layer_props <- get_epi_layer_props(epi_day0_A_counts)
epi_day0_B_layer_props <- get_epi_layer_props(epi_day0_B_counts)

layer_distribution_overlap_epi_day0 <- matrix(
  NA_real_,
  nrow = nrow(S_epi_day0_summary),
  ncol = ncol(S_epi_day0_summary),
  dimnames = dimnames(S_epi_day0_summary)
)

for (i in rownames(S_epi_day0_summary)) {
  for (j in colnames(S_epi_day0_summary)) {
    
    pi <- epi_day0_A_layer_props %>%
      filter(Tier2 == i) %>%
      select(layer, p_i = p)
    
    pj <- epi_day0_B_layer_props %>%
      filter(Tier2 == j) %>%
      select(layer, p_j = p)
    
    pp <- full_join(pi, pj, by = "layer") %>%
      mutate(
        p_i = tidyr::replace_na(p_i, 0),
        p_j = tidyr::replace_na(p_j, 0)
      )
    
    layer_distribution_overlap_epi_day0[i, j] <- sum(sqrt(pp$p_i * pp$p_j))
  }
}

layer_distribution_overlap_epi_day0_gamma <- layer_distribution_overlap_epi_day0 ^ gamma_epi_day0
S_epi_day0_final_mixture_aware <- S_epi_day0_summary * layer_distribution_overlap_epi_day0_gamma

# ============================================================
# 6. Reorder epithelial matrices
# ============================================================

S_epi_day0_summary_ordered <- order_epi_matrix(S_epi_day0_summary)
layer_distribution_overlap_epi_day0_ordered <- order_epi_matrix(layer_distribution_overlap_epi_day0)
S_epi_day0_final_mixture_aware_ordered <- order_epi_matrix(S_epi_day0_final_mixture_aware)
cell_weight_sum_epi_day0_ordered <- order_epi_matrix(cell_weight_sum_epi_day0)
layer_coverage_epi_day0_ordered <- order_epi_matrix(layer_coverage_epi_day0)

# ============================================================
# 7. Heatmaps with numbers
# ============================================================

epi_heat_cols <- colorRampPalette(c("white", "gold", "red"))(100)
overlap_cols <- colorRampPalette(c("white", "skyblue", "navy"))(100)
coverage_cols <- colorRampPalette(c("white", "grey80", "black"))(100)

safe_pheatmap(
  S_epi_day0_summary_ordered,
  main = "Step 2: epithelial Day0 vs Day0 weighted spatial similarity",

  fontsize_number = 7,

)

safe_pheatmap(

)

safe_pheatmap(
  S_epi_day0_final_mixture_aware_ordered,
  main = paste0("Final: epithelial Day0 vs Day0 mixture-aware similarity, gamma = ", gamma_epi_day0),
  color = epi_heat_cols,
  show_numbers = TRUE,
  number_format = "%.2f",
  fontsize_number = 7,

# ============================================================
# 8. Self-match diagnostics
# ============================================================

get_self_match_epi <- function(S_mat) {
  
  bind_rows(lapply(rownames(S_mat), function(i) {
    
    rank_table <- tibble(
      Day0_B_Tier2 = colnames(S_mat),
      similarity = as.numeric(S_mat[i, ])
    ) %>%
      filter(is.finite(similarity)) %>%
      arrange(desc(similarity)) %>%
      mutate(rank = row_number())
    
    self_row <- rank_table %>%
      filter(Day0_B_Tier2 == i)
    
    tibble(
      Day0_A_Tier2 = i,
      top_Day0_B_Tier2 = if (nrow(rank_table) == 0) NA_character_ else rank_table$Day0_B_Tier2[1],
      top_similarity = if (nrow(rank_table) == 0) NA_real_ else rank_table$similarity[1],
      self_similarity = if (nrow(self_row) == 0) NA_real_ else self_row$similarity[1],
      self_rank = if (nrow(self_row) == 0) NA_real_ else self_row$rank[1],
      self_is_top1 = if (nrow(self_row) == 0) FALSE else self_row$rank[1] == 1,
      top5_Day0_B_matches = get_top_matches_epi(i, S_mat, top_n = 5)
    )
  }))
}

epi_day0_self_match <- get_self_match_epi(S_epi_day0_final_mixture_aware_ordered)

epi_day0_self_match %>%
  arrange(self_rank, desc(self_similarity))

epi_day0_self_match %>%
  summarise(
    n_epi_cell_types = n(),
    n_self_top1 = sum(self_is_top1, na.rm = TRUE),
    prop_self_top1 = mean(self_is_top1, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_self_rank = median(self_rank, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_self_similarity = mean(self_similarity, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# ============================================================
# 9. Ground-truth epithelial sanity check with rank / total
# ============================================================

epi_crypt_axis_pairs <- tibble::tribble(
  ~Day0_A_Tier2, ~Day0_B_Tier2, ~expected_relationship, ~priority,
  "Stem cells",  "Stem cells",  "self-match; crypt base", "high",
  "TA",          "TA",          "self-match; transit-amplifying", "high",
  "Colonocytes", "Colonocytes", "self-match; crypt tip mature epithelial", "high",
  "Goblet 1",    "Goblet 1",    "self-match; crypt-base goblet", "high",
  "Goblet 2",    "Goblet 2",    "self-match; crypt-tip goblet", "high",
  "Stem cells",  "TA",          "adjacent along crypt base-to-tip axis", "medium",
  "TA",          "Colonocytes", "adjacent along crypt base-to-tip axis", "medium",
  "Goblet 1",    "Stem cells",  "both crypt-base associated", "medium",
  "Goblet 2",    "Colonocytes", "both crypt-tip associated", "medium",
  "Stem cells",  "Colonocytes", "same lineage but farther apart", "low"
)

epi_crypt_axis_check <- epi_crypt_axis_pairs %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    step2_weighted_summary_similarity = pull_matrix_value_epi(
      S_epi_day0_summary_ordered,
      Day0_A_Tier2,
      Day0_B_Tier2
    ),
    step3_layer_distribution_overlap = pull_matrix_value_epi(
      layer_distribution_overlap_epi_day0_ordered,
      Day0_A_Tier2,
      Day0_B_Tier2
    ),
    final_mixture_aware_similarity = pull_matrix_value_epi(
      S_epi_day0_final_mixture_aware_ordered,
      Day0_A_Tier2,
      Day0_B_Tier2
    ),
    total_cell_weight = pull_matrix_value_epi(
      cell_weight_sum_epi_day0_ordered,
      Day0_A_Tier2,
      Day0_B_Tier2
    ),
    layer_coverage = pull_matrix_value_epi(
      layer_coverage_epi_day0_ordered,
      Day0_A_Tier2,
      Day0_B_Tier2
    ),
    rank_among_Day0_B_epi = get_rank_for_pair_epi(
      Day0_A_Tier2,
      Day0_B_Tier2,
      S_epi_day0_final_mixture_aware_ordered
    ),
    n_candidate_Day0_B_epi = ifelse(
      Day0_A_Tier2 %in% rownames(S_epi_day0_final_mixture_aware_ordered),
      sum(is.finite(S_epi_day0_final_mixture_aware_ordered[Day0_A_Tier2, ])),
      NA_integer_
    ),
    rank_out_of_total = ifelse(
      is.finite(rank_among_Day0_B_epi),
      paste0(rank_among_Day0_B_epi, " / ", n_candidate_Day0_B_epi),
      NA_character_
    ),
    percentile_rank = ifelse(
      is.finite(rank_among_Day0_B_epi) & n_candidate_Day0_B_epi > 1,
      1 - (rank_among_Day0_B_epi - 1) / (n_candidate_Day0_B_epi - 1),
      NA_real_
    ),
    is_top1 = rank_among_Day0_B_epi == 1,
    is_top3 = rank_among_Day0_B_epi <= 3,
    top5_Day0_B_matches_for_Day0_A = get_top_matches_epi(
      Day0_A_Tier2,
      S_epi_day0_final_mixture_aware_ordered,
      top_n = 5
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

epi_crypt_axis_check %>%
  arrange(priority, rank_among_Day0_B_epi, desc(final_mixture_aware_similarity))

epi_crypt_axis_summary <- epi_crypt_axis_check %>%
  summarise(
    n_ground_truth_pairs = n(),
    n_testable_pairs = sum(is.finite(rank_among_Day0_B_epi)),
    n_top1 = sum(is_top1, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_top3 = sum(is_top3, na.rm = TRUE),
    prop_top1 = mean(is_top1, na.rm = TRUE),
    prop_top3 = mean(is_top3, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_rank = median(rank_among_Day0_B_epi, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_percentile_rank = mean(percentile_rank, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_final_similarity = mean(final_mixture_aware_similarity, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

epi_crypt_axis_summary
```

## Fibro
```{r}
# ============================================================
# Fibro: Day0 vs Day0 fibroblast-only benchmark
# Revised version:
#   1. Uses fibroblast Tier1 only
#   2. Uses stratified split within layer × Tier2
#   3. Uses lower post-split threshold
#   4. Reorders fibroblasts by MU / SM / ME ground truth
#   5. Reports ground-truth rank as rank / total candidates
# ============================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Fine-tuning parameters for fibroblast benchmark
# ------------------------------------------------------------

min_cells_fibro <- 15
gamma_fibro_day0 <- 1

use_only_MU_for_fibro <- FALSE

if (use_only_MU_for_fibro) {
  layers_fibro <- "MU"
} else {
  layers_fibro <- c("MU", "SM", "ME")
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Fibroblast Tier1 filter
# ------------------------------------------------------------

is_fibro_tier1 <- function(x) {
  grepl("fibro", x, ignore.case = TRUE)
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Fibroblast biological order based on MU / SM / ME ground truth
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# MU: Fibro 6 -> Fibro 13 -> Fibro 2
# SM/ME enriched: Fibro 7
# ME: Fibro 15
# ------------------------------------------------------------

expected_fibro_order <- c(
  "Fibro 6",
  "Fibro 13",
  "Fibro 2",
  "Fibro 7",
  "Fibro 15",
  "Fibro 1",
  "Fibro 4",
  "FRC",
  "Fibro 5",
  "Fibro 12",
  "Pericyte 1",
  "Pericyte 2",
  "IAF 2"
)

order_fibro_matrix <- function(mat) {
  
  row_order <- c(
    intersect(expected_fibro_order, rownames(mat)),
    setdiff(rownames(mat), expected_fibro_order)
  )
  
  col_order <- c(
    intersect(expected_fibro_order, colnames(mat)),
    setdiff(colnames(mat), expected_fibro_order)
  )
  
  mat[row_order, col_order, drop = FALSE]
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Read Healthy xyt_mapped files and keep fibroblast Tier1 only
# ------------------------------------------------------------

healthy_fibro_benchmark <- bind_rows(lapply(layers_fibro, function(ly) {
  read_csv(
    file.path(outdir, paste0("Healthy_xyt_mapped_", ly, ".csv")),
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )
})) %>%
  mutate(
    layer = as.character(layer),
    Tier1 = as.character(Tier1),
    Tier2 = as.character(Tier2),
    r_for_jsd = as.numeric(r_for_jsd)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    layer %in% layers_fibro,
    !is.na(Tier1),
    !is.na(Tier2),
    is_fibro_tier1(Tier1),
    is.finite(r_for_jsd),
    r_for_jsd >= 0,
    r_for_jsd <= 1
  )

healthy_fibro_benchmark %>%
  count(layer, Tier2, name = "n_cells") %>%
  arrange(layer, desc(n_cells))

healthy_fibro_benchmark %>%
  count(Tier2, name = "total_cells") %>%
  arrange(desc(total_cells))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Stratified split within layer × Tier2
# ------------------------------------------------------------

healthy_fibro_benchmark <- healthy_fibro_benchmark %>%
  group_by(layer, Tier2) %>%
  mutate(
    benchmark_group = sample(
      rep(c("Day0_A", "Day0_B"), length.out = n())
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

table(healthy_fibro_benchmark$benchmark_group)

healthy_fibro_benchmark %>%
  count(layer, Tier2, benchmark_group, name = "n_cells") %>%
  arrange(layer, Tier2, benchmark_group)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Step 1: layer-specific fibroblast JSD similarity
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Reuse compute_epi_benchmark_layer_jsd() by temporarily assigning
# fibroblast benchmark data to healthy_epi_benchmark.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

healthy_epi_benchmark_backup <- healthy_epi_benchmark
healthy_epi_benchmark <- healthy_fibro_benchmark

fibro_day0_jsd_list <- setNames(
  lapply(layers_fibro, function(ly) {
    compute_epi_benchmark_layer_jsd(
      layer_name = ly,
      coord = "r_for_jsd",
      min_cells = min_cells_fibro,
      plot_heatmap = FALSE
    )
  }),
  layers_fibro
)

healthy_epi_benchmark <- healthy_epi_benchmark_backup

# Step 1 heatmaps with fibroblast ordering
for (ly in names(fibro_day0_jsd_list)) {
  
  S_layer <- fibro_day0_jsd_list[[ly]]$S
  
  safe_pheatmap(
    order_fibro_matrix(S_layer),
    main = paste0("Step 1: fibroblast Day0_A vs Day0_B ", ly),
    color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "gold", "red"))(100),
    show_numbers = TRUE,
    number_format = "%.2f",
    fontsize_number = 7,
    fontsize_row = 9,
    fontsize_col = 9,
    angle_col = 45
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Step 2: cell-count-weighted summary across layers
# ------------------------------------------------------------

fibro_day0_A_counts <- healthy_fibro_benchmark %>%
  filter(benchmark_group == "Day0_A") %>%
  count(layer, Tier2, name = "n") %>%

fibro_day0_B_counts <- healthy_fibro_benchmark %>%

all_rows_fibro_day0 <- sort(unique(unlist(lapply(fibro_day0_jsd_list, function(x) rownames(x$S)))))
all_cols_fibro_day0 <- sort(unique(unlist(lapply(fibro_day0_jsd_list, function(x) colnames(x$S)))))

S_num_fibro_day0 <- matrix(0, length(all_rows_fibro_day0), length(all_cols_fibro_day0),
                           dimnames = list(all_rows_fibro_day0, all_cols_fibro_day0))
S_den_fibro_day0 <- matrix(0, length(all_rows_fibro_day0), length(all_cols_fibro_day0),
                           dimnames = list(all_rows_fibro_day0, all_cols_fibro_day0))
layer_coverage_fibro_day0 <- matrix(0, length(all_rows_fibro_day0), length(all_cols_fibro_day0),
                                    dimnames = list(all_rows_fibro_day0, all_cols_fibro_day0))
cell_weight_sum_fibro_day0 <- matrix(0, length(all_rows_fibro_day0), length(all_cols_fibro_day0),
                                     dimnames = list(all_rows_fibro_day0, all_cols_fibro_day0))

for (ly in layers_fibro) {
  
  S_layer <- fibro_day0_jsd_list[[ly]]$S
  
  nA_layer <- fibro_day0_A_counts %>% filter(layer == ly)

  for (i in rownames(S_layer)) {
```
