```{r}
      if (!is.finite(sij)) next
      
      n_i <- nA_layer %>% filter(Tier2 == i) %>% pull(n)
      n_j <- nB_layer %>% filter(Tier2 == j) %>% pull(n)
      
      if (length(n_i) == 0 || length(n_j) == 0) next
      
      w <- sqrt(n_i * n_j)
      if (!is.finite(w) || w <= 0) next
      
      S_num_fibro_day0[i, j] <- S_num_fibro_day0[i, j] + w * sij
      S_den_fibro_day0[i, j] <- S_den_fibro_day0[i, j] + w
      layer_coverage_fibro_day0[i, j] <- layer_coverage_fibro_day0[i, j] + 1
      cell_weight_sum_fibro_day0[i, j] <- cell_weight_sum_fibro_day0[i, j] + w
    }
  }
}

S_fibro_day0_summary <- S_num_fibro_day0 / S_den_fibro_day0
S_fibro_day0_summary[S_den_fibro_day0 == 0] <- NA

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Step 3: anatomical layer-distribution overlap
# ------------------------------------------------------------

fibro_day0_A_layer_props <- get_epi_layer_props(fibro_day0_A_counts)
fibro_day0_B_layer_props <- get_epi_layer_props(fibro_day0_B_counts)

layer_distribution_overlap_fibro_day0 <- matrix(
  NA_real_,
  nrow = nrow(S_fibro_day0_summary),
  ncol = ncol(S_fibro_day0_summary),
  dimnames = dimnames(S_fibro_day0_summary)
)

for (i in rownames(S_fibro_day0_summary)) {
  for (j in colnames(S_fibro_day0_summary)) {
    
    pi <- fibro_day0_A_layer_props %>%
      filter(Tier2 == i) %>%
      select(layer, p_i = p)
    
    pj <- fibro_day0_B_layer_props %>%
      filter(Tier2 == j) %>%
      select(layer, p_j = p)
    
    pp <- full_join(pi, pj, by = "layer") %>%
      mutate(
        p_i = tidyr::replace_na(p_i, 0),
        p_j = tidyr::replace_na(p_j, 0)
      )
    
    layer_distribution_overlap_fibro_day0[i, j] <- sum(sqrt(pp$p_i * pp$p_j))
  }
}

layer_distribution_overlap_fibro_day0_gamma <- layer_distribution_overlap_fibro_day0 ^ gamma_fibro_day0
S_fibro_day0_final_mixture_aware <- S_fibro_day0_summary * layer_distribution_overlap_fibro_day0_gamma

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Reorder fibroblast matrices
# ------------------------------------------------------------

S_fibro_day0_summary_ordered <- order_fibro_matrix(S_fibro_day0_summary)
layer_distribution_overlap_fibro_day0_ordered <- order_fibro_matrix(layer_distribution_overlap_fibro_day0)
S_fibro_day0_final_mixture_aware_ordered <- order_fibro_matrix(S_fibro_day0_final_mixture_aware)
cell_weight_sum_fibro_day0_ordered <- order_fibro_matrix(cell_weight_sum_fibro_day0)
layer_coverage_fibro_day0_ordered <- order_fibro_matrix(layer_coverage_fibro_day0)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Fibroblast heatmaps
# ------------------------------------------------------------

fibro_heat_cols <- colorRampPalette(c("white", "gold", "red"))(100)
fibro_overlap_cols <- colorRampPalette(c("white", "skyblue", "navy"))(100)
fibro_coverage_cols <- colorRampPalette(c("white", "grey80", "black"))(100)

safe_pheatmap(
  S_fibro_day0_summary_ordered,
  main = "Step 2: fibroblast Day0 vs Day0 weighted spatial similarity",
  color = fibro_heat_cols,
  show_numbers = TRUE,
  number_format = "%.2f",
  fontsize_number = 7,
  fontsize_row = 9,
  fontsize_col = 9,
  angle_col = 45
)

safe_pheatmap(
  layer_distribution_overlap_fibro_day0_ordered,
  main = "Step 3 only: fibroblast layer-distribution overlap",
  color = fibro_overlap_cols,
  show_numbers = TRUE,
  number_format = "%.2f",
  fontsize_number = 7,
  fontsize_row = 9,
  fontsize_col = 9,
  angle_col = 45
)

safe_pheatmap(
  S_fibro_day0_final_mixture_aware_ordered,
  main = paste0("Final: fibroblast Day0 vs Day0 mixture-aware similarity, gamma = ", gamma_fibro_day0),
  color = fibro_heat_cols,
  show_numbers = TRUE,
  number_format = "%.2f",
  fontsize_number = 7,
  fontsize_row = 9,
  fontsize_col = 9,
  angle_col = 45
)

safe_pheatmap(
  layer_coverage_fibro_day0_ordered,
  main = "QC: fibroblast layer coverage count",
  color = fibro_coverage_cols,
  show_numbers = TRUE,
  number_format = "%.0f",
  fontsize_number = 7,
  fontsize_row = 9,
  fontsize_col = 9,
  angle_col = 45
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Self-match diagnostics
# ------------------------------------------------------------

fibro_day0_self_match <- get_self_match_epi(
  S_fibro_day0_final_mixture_aware_ordered
)

fibro_day0_self_match %>%
  arrange(self_rank, desc(self_similarity))

fibro_day0_self_match %>%
  summarise(
    n_fibro_cell_types = n(),
    n_self_top1 = sum(self_is_top1, na.rm = TRUE),
    prop_self_top1 = mean(self_is_top1, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_self_rank = median(self_rank, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_self_similarity = mean(self_similarity, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Fibroblast spatial sanity check with rank / total
# ------------------------------------------------------------

fibro_ground_truth_pairs <- tibble::tribble(
  ~Day0_A_Tier2, ~Day0_B_Tier2, ~expected_relationship, ~expected_layer, ~priority,
  
  "Fibro 6",  "Fibro 6",  "self-match; MU crypt-base fibroblast", "MU", "high",
  "Fibro 13", "Fibro 13", "self-match; MU lamina propria / broad mucosal fibroblast", "MU", "high",
  "Fibro 2",  "Fibro 2",  "self-match; MU crypt-tip / telocyte-like fibroblast", "MU", "high",
  "Fibro 7",  "Fibro 7",  "self-match; SM-enriched fibroblast with SM/ME distribution", "SM/ME", "high",
  "Fibro 15", "Fibro 15", "self-match; ME muscle-layer / myenteric-plexus-associated", "ME", "high",
  
  "Fibro 6",  "Fibro 13", "MU local relationship: crypt base -> lamina propria", "MU", "medium",
  "Fibro 13", "Fibro 2",  "MU local relationship: lamina propria -> crypt tip", "MU", "medium",
  "Fibro 6",  "Fibro 2",  "MU crypt-axis relationship: base -> tip", "MU", "medium",
  
  "Fibro 7",  "Fibro 15", "SM/ME neighboring stromal relationship", "SM/ME", "medium"
)

fibro_ground_truth_check <- fibro_ground_truth_pairs %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    step2_weighted_summary_similarity = pull_matrix_value_epi(
      S_fibro_day0_summary_ordered,
      Day0_A_Tier2,
      Day0_B_Tier2
    ),
    step3_layer_distribution_overlap = pull_matrix_value_epi(
      layer_distribution_overlap_fibro_day0_ordered,
      Day0_A_Tier2,
      Day0_B_Tier2
    ),
    final_mixture_aware_similarity = pull_matrix_value_epi(
      S_fibro_day0_final_mixture_aware_ordered,
      Day0_A_Tier2,
      Day0_B_Tier2
    ),
    total_cell_weight = pull_matrix_value_epi(
      cell_weight_sum_fibro_day0_ordered,
      Day0_A_Tier2,
      Day0_B_Tier2
    ),
    layer_coverage = pull_matrix_value_epi(
      layer_coverage_fibro_day0_ordered,
      Day0_A_Tier2,
      Day0_B_Tier2
    ),
    rank_among_Day0_B_fibro = get_rank_for_pair_epi(
      Day0_A_Tier2,
      Day0_B_Tier2,
      S_fibro_day0_final_mixture_aware_ordered
    ),
    n_candidate_Day0_B_fibro = ifelse(
      Day0_A_Tier2 %in% rownames(S_fibro_day0_final_mixture_aware_ordered),
      sum(is.finite(S_fibro_day0_final_mixture_aware_ordered[Day0_A_Tier2, ])),
      NA_integer_
    ),
    rank_out_of_total = ifelse(
      is.finite(rank_among_Day0_B_fibro),
      paste0(rank_among_Day0_B_fibro, " / ", n_candidate_Day0_B_fibro),
      NA_character_
    ),
    percentile_rank = ifelse(
      is.finite(rank_among_Day0_B_fibro) & n_candidate_Day0_B_fibro > 1,
      1 - (rank_among_Day0_B_fibro - 1) / (n_candidate_Day0_B_fibro - 1),
      NA_real_
    ),
    is_top1 = rank_among_Day0_B_fibro == 1,
    is_top3 = rank_among_Day0_B_fibro <= 3,
    top5_Day0_B_matches_for_Day0_A = get_top_matches_epi(
      Day0_A_Tier2,
      S_fibro_day0_final_mixture_aware_ordered,
      top_n = 5
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

fibro_ground_truth_check %>%
  arrange(priority, rank_among_Day0_B_fibro, desc(final_mixture_aware_similarity))

fibro_ground_truth_summary <- fibro_ground_truth_check %>%
  summarise(
    n_ground_truth_pairs = n(),
    n_testable_pairs = sum(is.finite(rank_among_Day0_B_fibro)),
    n_top1 = sum(is_top1, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_top3 = sum(is_top3, na.rm = TRUE),
    prop_top1 = mean(is_top1, na.rm = TRUE),
    prop_top3 = mean(is_top3, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_rank = median(rank_among_Day0_B_fibro, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_percentile_rank = mean(percentile_rank, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_final_similarity = mean(final_mixture_aware_similarity, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

fibro_ground_truth_summary
```

## specific check
```{r}
# ============================================================
# Specific spatial check for unexpected Day0_A vs Day0_B pairs
# ============================================================
# Works for either:
#   check_dataset = "epi"   -> uses healthy_epi_benchmark
#   check_dataset = "fibro" -> uses healthy_fibro_benchmark
#
# It generates:
#   1. Whole Healthy Day0 plot
#   2. Day0_A-only plot
#   3. Day0_B-only plot
#   4. Actual benchmark-role plot:
#        Day0_A selected Tier2 vs Day0_B selected Tier2
#   5. Count table by layer and split
#   6. Similarity/rank table for the selected pair
# ============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tibble)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 0. Choose dataset and pair to inspect
# ------------------------------------------------------------

check_dataset <- "epi"
# options:
#   "epi"
#   "fibro"

check_A_tier2 <- "TA"
check_B_tier2 <- "IAE 2"

# Examples:
# check_dataset <- "epi"
# check_A_tier2 <- "TA"
# check_B_tier2 <- "Colonocytes"
#
# check_dataset <- "fibro"
# check_A_tier2 <- "Pericyte 2"
# check_B_tier2 <- "Fibro 7"

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Select correct benchmark object and matrices
# ------------------------------------------------------------

if (check_dataset == "epi") {
  
  check_df <- healthy_epi_benchmark
  
  check_S_step2 <- S_epi_day0_summary_ordered
  check_S_final <- S_epi_day0_final_mixture_aware_ordered
  check_O_step3 <- layer_distribution_overlap_epi_day0_ordered
  check_layer_coverage <- layer_coverage_epi_day0_ordered
  check_cell_weight <- cell_weight_sum_epi_day0_ordered
  
} else if (check_dataset == "fibro") {
  
  check_df <- healthy_fibro_benchmark
  
  check_S_step2 <- S_fibro_day0_summary_ordered
  check_S_final <- S_fibro_day0_final_mixture_aware_ordered
  check_O_step3 <- layer_distribution_overlap_fibro_day0_ordered
  check_layer_coverage <- layer_coverage_fibro_day0_ordered
  check_cell_weight <- cell_weight_sum_fibro_day0_ordered
  
} else {
  
  stop("check_dataset must be either 'epi' or 'fibro'")
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Check whether selected Tier2 labels exist
# ------------------------------------------------------------

selected_label_check <- check_df %>%
  filter(Tier2 %in% c(check_A_tier2, check_B_tier2)) %>%
  count(Tier2, name = "n_cells") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_cells))

selected_label_check

if (nrow(selected_label_check) == 0) {
  message("Selected Tier2 labels were not found. Available Tier2 labels are:")
  print(
    check_df %>%
      count(Tier2, name = "n_cells") %>%
      arrange(desc(n_cells))
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Count selected pair by layer and split
# ------------------------------------------------------------

specific_pair_counts <- check_df %>%
  filter(Tier2 %in% c(check_A_tier2, check_B_tier2)) %>%
  count(benchmark_group, layer, Tier2, name = "n_cells") %>%
  arrange(Tier2, benchmark_group, layer)

specific_pair_counts

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Plot whole Day0 / Day0_A / Day0_B
# ------------------------------------------------------------

plot_specific_pair_layer <- function(df,
                                     tier2_A,
                                     tier2_B,
                                     title_prefix = "Specific pair check") {
  
  df_plot <- df %>%
    mutate(
      layer = as.character(layer),
      Tier2 = as.character(Tier2),
      pair_status = case_when(
        Tier2 == tier2_A ~ tier2_A,
        Tier2 == tier2_B ~ tier2_B,
        TRUE ~ "Background"
      ),
      pair_status = factor(
        pair_status,
        levels = c("Background", tier2_A, tier2_B)
      )
    )
  
  ggplot() +
    geom_point(
      data = df_plot,
      aes(x = x, y = y),
      color = "grey88",
      size = 0.18,
      alpha = 0.35
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = df_plot %>% filter(pair_status != "Background"),
      aes(x = x, y = y, color = pair_status),
      size = 0.75,
      alpha = 0.95
    ) +
    coord_equal() +
    facet_wrap(~ layer) +
    theme_void() +
    labs(
      title = paste0(title_prefix, ": ", tier2_A, " vs ", tier2_B),
      color = "Tier2"
    ) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 13),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 11)
    )
}

# Whole Healthy Day0
p_whole_day0 <- plot_specific_pair_layer(
  df = check_df,
  tier2_A = check_A_tier2,
  tier2_B = check_B_tier2,
  title_prefix = "Whole Healthy Day0"
)

p_whole_day0

# Day0_A only
p_day0_A <- plot_specific_pair_layer(
  df = check_df %>% filter(benchmark_group == "Day0_A"),
  tier2_A = check_A_tier2,
  tier2_B = check_B_tier2,
  title_prefix = "Day0_A only"
)

p_day0_A

# Day0_B only
p_day0_B <- plot_specific_pair_layer(
  df = check_df %>% filter(benchmark_group == "Day0_B"),
  tier2_A = check_A_tier2,
  tier2_B = check_B_tier2,
  title_prefix = "Day0_B only"
)

p_day0_B

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Plot actual benchmark role:
#    Day0_A selected Tier2 -> Day0_B selected Tier2
# ------------------------------------------------------------

plot_actual_benchmark_pair <- function(df,
                                       tier2_A,
                                       tier2_B,
                                       title_prefix = "Actual benchmark comparison") {
  
  df_pair <- df %>%
    filter(
      (benchmark_group == "Day0_A" & Tier2 == tier2_A) |
        (benchmark_group == "Day0_B" & Tier2 == tier2_B)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      pair_status = case_when(
        benchmark_group == "Day0_A" & Tier2 == tier2_A ~ paste0("Day0_A: ", tier2_A),
        benchmark_group == "Day0_B" & Tier2 == tier2_B ~ paste0("Day0_B: ", tier2_B),
        TRUE ~ "Other"
      ),
      pair_status = factor(
        pair_status,
        levels = c(
          paste0("Day0_A: ", tier2_A),
          paste0("Day0_B: ", tier2_B)
        )
      )
    )
  
  ggplot() +
    geom_point(
      data = df,
      aes(x = x, y = y),
      color = "grey88",
      size = 0.18,
      alpha = 0.35
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = df_pair,
      aes(x = x, y = y, color = pair_status),
      size = 0.8,
      alpha = 0.95
    ) +
    coord_equal() +
    facet_wrap(~ layer) +
    theme_void() +
    labs(
      title = paste0(
        title_prefix,
        ": Day0_A ",
        tier2_A,
        " -> Day0_B ",
        tier2_B
      ),
      color = "Benchmark role"
    ) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 13),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 11)
    )
}

p_actual_pair <- plot_actual_benchmark_pair(
  df = check_df,
  tier2_A = check_A_tier2,
  tier2_B = check_B_tier2
)

p_actual_pair

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Pull similarity and rank for selected pair
# ------------------------------------------------------------

specific_pair_similarity <- tibble(
  dataset = check_dataset,
  Day0_A_Tier2 = check_A_tier2,
  Day0_B_Tier2 = check_B_tier2,
  
  step2_similarity = pull_matrix_value_epi(
    check_S_step2,
    check_A_tier2,
    check_B_tier2
  ),
  
  step3_layer_overlap = pull_matrix_value_epi(
    check_O_step3,
    check_A_tier2,
    check_B_tier2
  ),
  
  final_similarity = pull_matrix_value_epi(
    check_S_final,
    check_A_tier2,
    check_B_tier2
  ),
  
  layer_coverage = pull_matrix_value_epi(
    check_layer_coverage,
    check_A_tier2,
    check_B_tier2
  ),
  
  total_cell_weight = pull_matrix_value_epi(
    check_cell_weight,
    check_A_tier2,
    check_B_tier2
  ),
  
  rank_among_Day0_B = get_rank_for_pair_epi(
    check_A_tier2,
    check_B_tier2,
    check_S_final
  ),
  
  n_candidate_Day0_B = ifelse(
    check_A_tier2 %in% rownames(check_S_final),
    sum(is.finite(check_S_final[check_A_tier2, ])),
    NA_integer_
  ),
  
  top5_Day0_B_matches = get_top_matches_epi(
    check_A_tier2,
    check_S_final,
    top_n = 5
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    rank_out_of_total = ifelse(
      is.finite(rank_among_Day0_B),
      paste0(rank_among_Day0_B, " / ", n_candidate_Day0_B),
      NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    dataset,
    Day0_A_Tier2,
    Day0_B_Tier2,
    step2_similarity,
    step3_layer_overlap,
    final_similarity,
    layer_coverage,
    total_cell_weight,
    rank_among_Day0_B,
    n_candidate_Day0_B,
    rank_out_of_total,
    top5_Day0_B_matches
  )

specific_pair_similarity

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Optional: show layer proportions for the selected pair
# ------------------------------------------------------------

specific_pair_layer_props <- check_df %>%
  filter(Tier2 %in% c(check_A_tier2, check_B_tier2)) %>%
  count(benchmark_group, Tier2, layer, name = "n") %>%
  group_by(benchmark_group, Tier2) %>%
  mutate(
    total_n = sum(n),
    prop = n / total_n
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(Tier2, benchmark_group, layer)

specific_pair_layer_props
```
